benefit: Sorghum-sudangrass cover crop in the rotation year before solanaceae suppresses root-knot nematode and lesion nematode populations through allelopathic dhurrin compounds. Best when sown in summer, mowed at 4 to 5 ft, and incorporated.

members.title: Sorghum-sudan cover the year before solanaceae block
members.body: Drill sorghum-sudangrass at 40 to 50 lb per acre in June. Mow once at 4 ft, allow regrowth, then mow and incorporate in late August. Follow with a winter cover before the solanaceae year.
